def get_model_name_map(models: Set[Union[Type[BaseModel], Type[Enum]]]) -> Dict[Union[Type[BaseModel], Type[Enum]], str]:
    model_name_map = {}
    for model in models:
        model_name = model.__name__
        # ensure uniqueness
        base_name = model_name
        counter = 1
        while model_name in model_name_map.values():
            model_name = f"{base_name}_{counter}"
            counter += 1
        model_name_map[model] = model_name
    return model_name_map
